summary: 60-year-old Patricia Goodwine of Cedar Grove was swept away on September 13, 2013 when floodwaters destroyed the home she had lived in for 37 years; eyewitnesses saw her in the water
notes: Body found Monday 2013-09-16 in a debris field west of Loveland; Larimer County coroner confirmed cause of death was drowning; search teams not named in source; September 2013 Front Range flood; 9th confirmed flood fatality
